en.text:
Ash on your hands before the sun is up. The hearth is cold, the water is colder, and the good room upstairs still smells of your stepsisters' powder.

The invitation has been on the table a week. Tonight the palace opens its doors, and every road to it passes the end of your garden. Nobody has asked you. Nobody has forbidden you either — only overlooked you, which is its own kind of answer.

zh.text:
天还没亮，你手上已经沾了灰。炉子是冷的，水更冷；楼上那间好屋子里，还留着两位姐姐身上的香粉味。

请柬在桌上放了整整一周。今晚王宫开门，通往那里的每条路都要经过你家花园尽头。没有人邀请你，也没有人明说不许——只是没人想到你，而这本身就是一种回答。
